name: Gutengrow Blocks
author: Masud Hasan

sections.description:
Design without limits | Commerce ready | Data connected | Lead capture focused | Lightning fast

Gutengrow Blocks turns the native WordPress editor into a growth platform. Build popups, capture leads, sell with Stripe, sync Google Sheets, and publish data-rich layouts without custom code. Each block ships with intuitive controls, responsive presets, and selective asset loading so that every page stays lean.

Whether you are launching funnels, publishing resources, or managing subscriptions, Gutengrow centralizes the tooling: Gutenberg blocks for the front end and a React-powered dashboard for analytics, Stripe transactions, and email submissions on the back end.

Why Choose Gutengrow?

  • Works with core Gutenberg – No need for additional builders. All blocks are native to the WordPress editor.
  • Performance first – Assets load only when a block is present. Minified CSS/JS and caching-friendly markup keep pages fast.
  • Conversion toolkit – Popups, opt-ins, countdowns, testimonials, and pricing tables are ready to drop into any page.
  • Stripe automation – Manage products, one-time payments, and recurring subscriptions from the same interface.
  • Data integrations – Google Sheets, Instagram, and dynamic charts keep content fresh and connected to live sources.
  • Admin visibility – View Stripe transactions, audit email submissions, and toggle block availability from one dashboard.
  • Scales with you – Modular architecture, regular updates, and REST-ready endpoints support advanced customization.

Perfect For:

  • Agencies & Freelancers – Deliver marketing sites and funnels quickly with reusable blocks.
  • Course Creators & Memberships – Sell access, handle Stripe subscriptions, and monitor conversions.
  • Marketers & Growth Teams – Launch popups, A/B offers, and gated content without developer queues.
  • Ecommerce & Service Brands – Showcase products, highlight benefits, and collect testimonials with minimal setup.
  • Ops & Data Teams – Surface Google Sheets, KPIs, and timelines directly inside CMS-driven pages.

Gutengrow Block Library Highlights

Gutengrow bundles high-impact blocks organized by outcome:

Lead Generation & Audience Growth

1. Email Subscription Forms – Inline opt-in blocks with multiple layouts, tag-based segmenting, success messaging, and duplicate prevention for clean lists.

2. Popup Builder – Launch modals from buttons, exit intent, timers, or manual triggers. Supports reusable templates, countdown timers, CTA analytics, and responsive design presets.

3. Unlock Popup – Content locker that reveals premium sections after opt-in or payment confirmation; perfect for lead magnets and gated downloads.

Commerce & Monetization

4. Stripe Product Manager – Sync Stripe products and prices, list them in Gutenberg, and launch secure checkout overlays. Includes REST endpoints, inventory helpers, and catalog filtering.

5. Stripe Subscriptions – Display membership tiers, connect recurring plans, and hand off to Stripe-hosted checkout with localized currencies and success/cancel routes.

6. Checkout Pages & Receipts – Ready-to-use success, cancel, and diagnostic templates keep the post-purchase journey on brand and trackable.

7. Feature Grid & Benefit Callouts – Present product advantages, pricing options, and plan comparisons with icons, badges, and contextual CTAs.

Data Visualization & Automation

8. Dynamic Chart – Animated bar, line, and pie charts with live color controls, conditional tooltips, and REST-friendly data feeds.

9. Dynamic Table – Searchable, sortable tables with pagination, zebra styles, and responsive stacking for large datasets.

10. Google Sheet Sync – Connect a published or web-app-enabled sheet and render real-time data in WordPress without manual imports.

11. Content Timeline – Showcase roadmaps, project milestones, or brand history with vertical or horizontal layouts and scroll animations.

Content & Engagement

12. Content Tabs – Organize long-form content into accessible tab sets with keyboard navigation and deep-linking support.

13. FAQ & Dynamic Accordions – Manage Q&A, help desks, or feature breakdowns with nested layouts, icons, and individually tracked panels.

14. Progress Bar – Linear and circular progress indicators with percentage counters, milestones, and animation delay controls.

15. Team, Testimonials, and Sliders – Highlight people, reviews, and case studies with customizable cards, star ratings, and autoplay sliders.

16. Dynamic Team – Pull team data from the database or REST endpoint and render it with filtering, categories, and per-member meta fields.

17. Popup Announcements – Deliver time-sensitive messaging (product launches, promos, alerts) with scheduling windows and reusable presets.

Social & Media

18. Instagram Feed – Authenticate with the Instagram Graph API and embed grids, masonry layouts, or sliders with live caching and failure fallbacks.

Admin & Workflow Tools

  • Toggle block availability per site to keep editor palettes lean.
  • React dashboard surfaces Stripe transactions, subscription analytics, and email submission exports (CSV ready).
  • Built-in database updater keeps custom tables (email log, Stripe cache) in sync across plugin versions.
  • Debug screens for Stripe webhooks, Google Sheets connectivity, and popup diagnostics accelerate support.

Getting Started in 3 Simple Steps

  1. Install & Activate – Upload the plugin ZIP or install from your WordPress dashboard, then activate Gutengrow Blocks.
  2. Open the Block Editor – Edit any page or post with Gutenberg and find the “GutenGrow Blocks” category in the inserter.
  3. Drag, Drop & Configure – Place a block, adjust content and styling controls, and publish. Optional: connect Stripe, Google Sheets, or Instagram from the Gutengrow admin page.

Use Cases & Examples

Conversion Landing Pages

  • Email Capture Overlay for hero opt-ins
  • Popup Builder for exit-intent offers and timers
  • Testimonial Slider for user proof
  • Progress Bar to showcase roadmap progress

Subscription & Membership Sites

  • Stripe Product Manager for plan listings
  • Stripe Subscriptions block for checkout handoff
  • Unlock Popup to gate premium lessons
  • Content Tabs for modular course outlines

SaaS & Data Dashboards

  • Google Sheet Sync to surface KPIs
  • Dynamic Chart for usage metrics
  • Dynamic Table for changelog or release notes
  • Feature Grid for highlighting tiers or integrations

Editorial & Community Hubs

  • Content Timeline for project history
  • Team block for contributor bios
  • FAQ Accordion for support centers
  • Instagram Feed for live community updates

Performance & Optimization

  • Selective asset loading ensures only used blocks enqueue styles/scripts.
  • Build output is minified and RTL-ready for global sites.
  • Works seamlessly with popular caching plugins and CDNs.
  • Optional lazy loading on image-heavy blocks keeps Largest Contentful Paint in check.
  • REST endpoints cache responses to reduce API calls (Stripe, Google, Instagram).
  • Admin tooling includes database repair utilities and cron health checks.

Security & Privacy

  • GDPR-aware lead capture with explicit consent fields and per-request IP logging.
  • All Stripe requests use official SDKs and WordPress nonces for secure checkout flows.
  • Google Sheets and Instagram tokens are stored via WordPress options with capability checks.
  • Regular code reviews keep the plugin aligned with WordPress coding standards.
  • Logging controls help diagnose integrations without exposing sensitive data.

Mobile Responsive

Every block honors responsive breakpoints out of the box:

  • Desktop layouts for marketing sites and dashboards.
  • Tablet breakpoints for grid-to-stack transitions.
  • Mobile-first layouts with touch-friendly controls, swipeable sliders, and accessible accordions.
  • Device-specific controls per block for typography, spacing, and visibility.

Design Flexibility

  • Native Gutenberg controls for typography, spacing, borders, and media.
  • Preset styles to jump-start layouts, with ability to override via global styles.
  • Support for gradients, background media, and animation delays.
  • Custom classes and data attributes for advanced theming or targeting.
  • Works with theme.json, block patterns, and full-site editing templates.

From WordPress Dashboard

  1. Navigate to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for Gutengrow Blocks.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP from https://gutengrow.com.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the ZIP file, click Install Now, then Activate Plugin.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • Gutenberg / Block Editor (bundled with core WordPress)
  • PHP 7.2 or higher
  • Optional: Stripe account, Google Sheets web app URL, Instagram Business access token

External Services

Gutengrow optionally connects to:

  • Stripe – Payment and subscription processing (Stripe Privacy Policy: https://stripe.com/privacy)
  • Google Sheets – Data sync via Apps Script web apps (Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy)
  • Instagram Graph API – Social feed embedding (Instagram Privacy Policy: https://privacycenter.instagram.com/policy)

Privacy Policy and Terms of Service

Please review our policies when enabling integrations:

  • Privacy Policy: https://gutengrow.com/privacy-policy/
  • Terms of Service: https://gutengrow.com/terms-of-service/
  • Stripe Services Agreement: https://stripe.com/legal
  • Google API Terms: https://developers.google.com/terms
  • Instagram Platform Policy: https://developers.facebook.com/terms/

Support

Need a hand?

Documentation: https://gutengrow.com/docs
Support Portal: https://gutengrow.com/support
Video Tutorials: https://gutengrow.com/tutorials
Community Updates: https://gutengrow.com/blog

We provide:

  • Step-by-step setup guides and developer docs
  • Video walkthroughs for each block and integration
  • Ticket-based support with SLA-backed responses
  • Regular product updates and beta previews

Official Website: https://gutengrow.com
Support: https://gutengrow.com/support

sections.faq:
Do I need a page builder?

No. Gutengrow runs on the native WordPress block editor. Simply open Gutenberg and search for blocks in the “GutenGrow Blocks” category.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

Gutengrow only loads assets for blocks that appear on a page. Static assets are minified and compatible with caching plugins, so performance impact stays minimal.

How do I connect Stripe?

Visit GutenGrow → Settings → Stripe, add your test or live API keys, and choose the default checkout URLs. The Stripe Product Manager and Subscriptions blocks will use those credentials automatically.

Where are leads stored?

Email captures are saved to a dedicated database table. View, search, filter, and export submissions from GutenGrow → Email Submissions in the WordPress dashboard.

What integrations are supported?

Google Sheets (REST/web app), Stripe payments and subscriptions, Instagram Graph API, and WordPress REST endpoints. Additional connectors can be added via hooks and filters.

Can I disable blocks I do not need?

Yes. The Gutengrow dashboard includes a block toggle screen so you can hide unused blocks from the editor and skip loading their assets.

Does it work with Full Site Editing themes?

Absolutely. Gutengrow respects global styles, theme.json settings, and block patterns across FSE-compatible themes.

Is there a developer API?

Hooks, filters, REST endpoints, and extendable React components ship with the plugin. Check the /docs folder for implementation details and examples.

How often is the plugin updated?

We ship iterative updates focused on stability, new blocks, and integration improvements. Join the changelog newsletter on gutengrow.com for release notes.

Can I request a new block?

Yes. Submit feature ideas via the support portal. We assess community requests regularly and post roadmaps inside the dashboard.

0.9.5
